I think it's a nice sign of the health and growth of the community that we now have calendar clashes. :-)

AFAIK these 2 are the only regularly scheduled online lessons/lectures, so it's not a pigeonhole principle thing that shows growth. The two out of two things clash.
(not to detract in any way from these cool new initiatives)

There are other regularly scheduled things, but they are either not online or not lessons/lectures (e.g. LLL / office hours / community meetings).

Regardless, very cool!
